entities.summary: John Christopher Courtenay Stevens is a British politician active in Rejoin EU, who founded and formerly led the Pro-Euro Conservative Party. A Conservative Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 1989 to 1999, he contested the Buckingham constituency in the 2010 general election as an independent, against Commons speaker John Bercow and came second with 10,331 votes (21.4%) compared to Bercow's 22,860 (47.3%).
